name: Fuyou
source:
The second demon created by Makoto. 
Curiously, both her appearance and personality matches Kikyou's, perhaps due to how much she means to Makoto. She knows how to do any and all housework and is the only one of his demons who can be seen by an average person without a sixth sense, which makes chores like shopping a cinch. However, due to that, she has no special abilities whatsoever. Of course, because she looks like Kikyou, seeing her angry is... quite a sight.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/751450/Nanairo_Reincarnation/]Steam[/url]]
